projects.title: Hybrid RAG Based Research Assistant
projects.description: A Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) application that ingests PDF, DOCX, TXT, and Markdown research papers, creating vector embeddings in ChromaDB to answer complex queries with context-aware citation tracking using Google Gemini API.

projects.title: ChefAI: Multi-Agent Cooking System
projects.description: An intelligent multi-agent system where specialized AI agents collaborate to deliver accurate recipe recommendations, ingredient substitution options, detailed nutrition analysis, and customized meal planning.
projects.highlight: Collaborative AI Agents • Dynamic Meal Planning

projects.title: American Sign Language Recognition System
projects.description: A real-time computer vision system using MediaPipe hand landmark detection and Scikit-learn classifiers to recognize ASL gestures with 98.73% prediction accuracy and a 30% inference speed enhancement.

projects.title: AgroCare: Plant Disease Detection & Treatment
projects.description: An end-to-end deep learning system utilizing CNNs trained on plant leaf images to classify 38 plant diseases with 98.12% accuracy and provide targeted treatment recommendations with reduced inference latency.
